news.q: Luka Dončić scored how many points in the Lakers' 132–123 win over the Jazz on Oct. 25?
news.fact: It was the top scoring game in the NBA that night.

news.q: Clayface opened at No. 1 at the box office on Oct. 23–25. How many million dollars did it make?
news.fact: It knocked Street Fighter, the previous weekend's No. 1, out of the top spot.

easy.q: In what year did Japan attack Pearl Harbor?
easy.fact: The attack came on a Sunday morning, December 7.

easy.q: In what year was Woodstock held?
easy.fact: About 400,000 people came to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

easy.q: How many states are in New England?
easy.fact: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island and Connecticut.

easy.q: How long is a marathon, in miles, to the nearest mile?
easy.fact: It's 26.2 miles, a distance that traces back to the 1908 London Olympics.

easy.q: In what year did the U.S. declare independence?
easy.fact: The Declaration was adopted on July 4.

medium.q: In what year was the Boston Tea Party?
medium.fact: Colonists dumped 342 chests of tea into Boston Harbor on December 16.

medium.q: In what year did Pac-Man arrive in arcades?
medium.fact: Its designer said the shape came from a pizza with a slice missing.

medium.q: How many U.S. states border the Mississippi River?
medium.fact: It starts at Lake Itasca in Minnesota.

medium.q: How many World Series have the New York Yankees won?
In what year was the golden spike driven to finish the first transcontinental railroad?
medium.fact: It went in at Promontory Summit, Utah, on May 10.

hard.q: In what year AD did Mount Vesuvius bury Pompeii?
hard.fact: The ash preserved the town so well that loaves of bread survived in its ovens.

hard.q: How many Jeopardy! games in a row did Ken Jennings win in 2004?
hard.fact: He later became the show's host.

hard.q: How tall is Mount Kilimanjaro, in feet?
hard.fact: Africa's highest peak is a dormant volcano in Tanzania.
